# VeraBASIC reference card

*Version 0, generated by `tools/vbgen.py` from `vbasic/keywords.tbl`; do not edit.*

`[ ]` may be left out, `|` one of, `...` more. Groups marked *later* are
checked and tokenized now; their statements run from the phase named in
the plan (VeraBASIC Run gives error 20 until then).

## Types and names

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| `a%` | integer | -32768 .. 32767 |
| `a` | float (an integer after `OPTION INTEGER`) | about 9 digits, ±1.7E38 |
| `a$` | string | 0 .. 255 characters |
| `12` `1.5E3` `$FF` `%1010` `"x"` | literals | `""` a quote in a string |

## Operators, from the highest priority

`^` · unary `-` · `*` `/` `\` `MOD` · `+` `-` · `SHL` `SHR` · `=` `<>` `<` `>` `<=` `>=` · `NOT` · `AND` · `OR` `XOR`

Comparisons give -1 (true) or 0. Integer `+ - *` stay integers (a result
that does not fit becomes a float); `/` and `^` give floats.

|---|---|
| `PRINT [#h,] [value] [{; \| ,} value] ... [; \| ,]` | Writes values to the console, or to file h |

|---|---|
| `FOR variable = first TO last [STEP step]` | Runs the lines up to NEXT with the variable counting from first to ... |

| `EXIT FOR` | Leaves the innermost FOR loop, past its NEXT |

## Procedures

|---|---|
| `SUB Name[(parameter, ...)] ... END SUB` | Defines a procedure |

| `EXIT SUB` | Returns from a SUB at once |
| `EXIT FUNCTION` | Returns from a FUNCTION at once with the value given so far |
| `CALL Name[(argument, ...)]` | Calls a SUB |
| `LOCAL name [, name] ...` | Inside a procedure: variables of its own, new at each call (so ... |
| `SHARED name [, name] ...` | Inside a procedure: says the names are the program's globals |

## Errors

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Stopped | 13 | Type mismatch |
| 2 | Syntax error | 14 | String too long |
| 3 | RETURN without GOSUB | 15 | Formula too complex |
| 4 | Out of DATA | 16 | Stack overflow |
| 5 | Illegal quantity | 17 | RESUME without error |
| 6 | Overflow | 18 | NEXT without FOR |
| 7 | Out of memory | 19 | Wrong number of arguments |
| 8 | Undefined line | 20 | Not available yet |
| 9 | Subscript out of range | 21 | Made by a newer VeraBASIC |
| 10 | Array already dimensioned | 22 | Not inside a SUB |
| 11 | Division by zero | 23 | BYREF needs a variable |
| 12 | Not an array |  |  |
| 200-255 | the program's own (`ERROR n, text`) | | |

## Running

| | |
|---|---|
| Ctrl+C, STOP | stops the program (error 1) |
| Alt+Tab | puts VeraBASIC Run aside, the program in the middle of its work |
| `vbasic.py build F.bas -o F.cvt` | the program document VeraBASIC Run opens |
| `vbasic.py run --rom rom.bin F.bas` | the reference interpreter on the PC |
